## Avatar

<!-- A screenshot or a GIF of your avatar in a few states. That's what we look at first. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] One folder `avatars/<id>/`, flat files, with a `manifest.json`
- [ ] `license` set (SPDX), and the artwork is mine or I may redistribute it under that license
- [ ] No one else's characters, logos or brands; any real person shown has agreed (see [what we accept](https://github.com/r45635/claude-pet-avatars/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-we-accept))
- [ ] Made with the help of an AI tool? Say which one here:
- [ ] `npm run avatar -- validate` passes, or I'm letting CI check it
- [ ] Tried on my own creature or in the browser preview (optional)
- [ ] For an update: `version` bumped
